Placeholder for binary attachments
===================================

This corpus intentionally ships only tiny text-based real attachments (.txt, .csv, .md).

The attachment manifests reference PDF/XLSX as placeholders pointing at this file so the
ingestion pipeline (fixes/phase-2 wiring: attachment content is downloaded, extracted, chunked,
and searchable — see the repo README's "Attachments" section) can be tested for the
"attachment present, parser invoked, gracefully degrades to no chunk" path without committing real
binaries:

  - application/pdf  (architecture-diagram.pdf)
  - application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet (capacity-plan.xlsx)

`extract_attachment` (pypdf/python-docx/openpyxl — real, installed, wired in) is handed THIS
file's plain text under a `.pdf`/`.xlsx` name; native parsing fails on the non-binary content and
falls closed to empty text (never raises), so `attachment_to_blocks` contributes nothing for
these two — proving the no-crash path, not real PDF/XLSX text extraction, which this fixture
corpus does not exercise:
  txt   -> plain read (real fixture)
  csv   -> tabular parse (real fixture)
  md    -> markdown parse (real fixture)
  pdf   -> text extraction (implemented; not exercised against a real binary here)
  docx  -> document parse (implemented; not exercised against a real binary here)
  xlsx  -> spreadsheet parse (implemented; not exercised against a real binary here)
